rationale: The already-default classification preserves incumbent Fast reuse. This draft candidate also selects scientifically eligible strict FP64 WB97M-V restricted exact-Direct cold VV10 owners at the same 192-AO unset floor, without a fixed upper ceiling. Standard promotion is not qualified: the complete 2026-11-13 trial passes science and lifetime gates but fails the declared Standard endpoint profitability gate. Do not merge this candidate as a qualified default or withdraw Fast to obtain parity. Smaller eligible owners remain opt-in; explicit 0 disables both and explicit 1 cannot bypass model, precision, lifetime or resource admission. The candidate selector no longer receives budget-presence flags. Strict arithmetic, screening, convergence and full-density final-state gates are unchanged. Five FP64 matrices and one scalar remain charged and optional, with bounded allocation fallback and force-pressure retirement. Qualification observations remain source/workload-specific, not universal speed or memory guarantees.
revisit_condition: Demonstrate a Standard complete-endpoint gain above the unchanged predeclared noise/profitability gate before promoting this draft. Requalify Standard/Fast cold/warm/moved energy/force endpoints, independent references, semantic work and resource/failure bounds before expanding scientific or resource admission. Preserve explicit rollback, the lower amortization floor and all numerical gates; do not infer profitability or omitted J/K applications from a delta-density count.
